evals.prompt: Write me a Zotero plugin that adds a right-click menu entry on items to copy a formatted citation key (AuthorYear) to the clipboard. Should work on Zotero 8 through 10.
evals.expected_output: Bootstrapped plugin using MenuManager on main/library/item, prefixed Fluent IDs with .label, clipboard via Zotero.Utilities.Internal.copyTextToClipboard or nsIClipboardHelper, strict_max_version 10.0.*, packaged xpi.

evals.prompt: My old Zotero plugin uses getSelectedCollection() and Zotero.Promise.map and it broke after updating. What do I need to change?
evals.expected_output: Identifies Zotero 10 plural getters and Zotero 8 Bluebird removal, gives replacements, mentions migrate-fx140 script and bumping strict_max_version.

evals.prompt: Add an item pane section to my zotero plugin that shows the item's DOI resolved against Crossref, and a column in the item list with the citation count.
evals.expected_output: Uses ItemPaneManager.registerSection with async rendering and ItemTreeManager.registerColumn with synchronous cached dataProvider; explains teardown.

evals.prompt: In my Zotero plugin I want a toolbar button that opens a dialog listing all items tagged 'to-read' in a table with checkboxes, so the user can pick some and create a saved search from them. Needs to work on Zotero 10.
evals.expected_output: XHTML dialog opened via openDialog with arguments, windowtype for re-focus, Zotero.Search without the legacy required argument, VirtualizedTable stylesheets and container height (or DialogHelper), dialogs closed in shutdown, toolbar button tracked and removed per window.
